verdict.rationale: The Comptroller runs web portals (Webfile/eSystems) and an open-data rail, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents analytics, cookie consent, or any tracking opt-out control. The pack covers only filing methods, payments, franchise tax requirements, open data and endpoint probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
